metadata.name: isolated_loan_v2
metadata.description: ZenLo V2 public loan: pro-rata or full-term interest, partial repayment, top-up, grace and recovery

instructions.name: accept_offer
docs: Starts the loan. Origination LTV uses the maximum contractual exposure, not just principal
plus interest, so a late fee can never make a fresh loan unhealthy by itself.

accounts.name: lender
docs: Receives the USDC vault rent the lender paid at create.

instructions.name: add_collateral
docs: Adds wSOL to an active loan. No price is needed; health refreshes at the next valid price.

instructions.name: claim_priced_recovery
docs: From 24 hours after grace, the lender takes collateral worth the payoff with no bonus. The
surplus returns to the borrower; any uncovered payoff is recorded as a shortfall.

instructions.name: claim_terminal
docs: From seven days after grace, the lender may take all remaining collateral without a price.
This is the agreed default remedy and can lose the borrower's surplus.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Collateral mint (the field keeps its V2 name). Canonical wSOL, or a mint whose enabled
`CollateralConfig` is the first remaining account; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: Collateral mint (the field keeps its V2 name). Canonical wSOL, or a mint whose enabled
`CollateralConfig` is the first remaining account; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: fund_request
docs: A lender funds an open request; the result is an active `OfferV2`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Once, by the upgrade authority (Story 26.2, same shape as `private_loan_v2`).

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Risk liquidation in the active term and grace: spot and EMA past the line, or spot alone
three points further (emergency).

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Receives the wSOL vault rent it paid at accept.

instructions.name: liquidate_overdue
docs: After grace, anyone may pay the payoff regardless of LTV and take collateral worth payoff
plus 5%; the surplus returns to the borrower.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Receives the wSOL vault rent it paid at accept.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Pays up to `amount`: accrued interest, then late fee, then principal. A payment at or above
the payoff closes the loan, takes only the payoff and returns all collateral. Open in every
phase until a settlement executes.

instructions.name: rotate_authorities
docs: Governance only.

instructions.name: set_collateral_config
docs: Governance only: create or update one asset's `CollateralConfig`.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Must be `config.authorities.governance`; pays rent on the first write.

accounts.name: collateral_config
docs: Created on the first write; mint and decimals are checked before every later write.

errors.name: WrongStatus

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral
errors.msg: Collateral is insufficient for the max LTV of the maximum exposure

errors.name: LoanHealthy
errors.msg: Loan is healthy and cannot be liquidated

errors.name: UnauthorizedLender
errors.msg: Only the lender may perform this action

errors.name: UnauthorizedBorrower
errors.msg: Only the borrower may perform this action

errors.name: SameBorrowerAndLender

errors.name: BorrowerCannotLiquidate
errors.msg: Borrower cannot liquidate their own loan

errors.name: InvalidTerms
errors.msg: Terms are outside the allowed caps or above the pricing ceiling

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: This settlement is not available yet

errors.name: InvalidPriceOwner
errors.msg: Price feed owner is invalid

errors.name: InvalidFeedId
errors.msg: Price feed id does not match the collateral's feed

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: Price is stale

errors.name: InvalidPrice

errors.name: InvalidExponent
errors.msg: Price exponent is outside the allowed range

errors.name: ZeroCollateralValue
errors.msg: Collateral value is zero

errors.name: InvalidUsdcMint

errors.name: InvalidWsolMint

errors.name: SameMint

errors.name: MintNotAllowed

errors.name: NotSettled

errors.name: RestrictedBorrower

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: PaymentAboveLimit

errors.name: CollateralNotConfigured

errors.name: CollateralDisabled

errors.name: InvalidCollateralConfig

errors.name: WrongAuthority

errors.name: InvalidAuthorities

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

fields.name: governance
docs: Squads vault PDA. Rotates every other key and holds the upgrade authority.

fields.name: ai_admin
docs: Registers and replaces the AI worker. Not a financial role.

fields.name: ai_worker
docs: Answers AI requests. Operational.

fields.name: liquidation_pool_admin
docs: Administers the liquidation-ticket pool's parameters.

fields.name: credential_issuer
docs: Issues credentials (later epics).

fields.name: keeper
docs: Triggers scheduled settlement checks. Operational and permissionless in effect.

types.name: CollateralConfig
docs: One collateral asset other than canonical wSOL. Seeds `["collateral", mint]`.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Copied from the mint at the first write; a mint's decimals never change.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth feed that prices this asset in USD. Every V1 oracle check still applies.

fields.name: max_ltv_bps
docs: Highest max LTV an offer or request in this asset may use.

fields.name: liquidation_ltv_bps
docs: Highest liquidation LTV an offer or request in this asset may use.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Gates new originations only. Servicing, liquidation and recovery of existing loans keep
reading the feed when an asset is disabled.

types.name: OfferV2
docs: One V2 loan, from open offer to terminal settlement. Seeds use the immutable `origin_lender`,
so the PDA keeps signing if the position is ever sold; repayments and claims go to
`current_lender`.

fields.name: borrower
docs: Default until accepted.

fields.name: restricted_borrower
docs: Default means anyone may accept; otherwise only this wallet (renewal offers).

fields.name: collateral_required
docs: Collateral required at accept.

fields.name: collateral_locked
docs: wSOL currently held for this loan (grows with top-ups).

fields.name: shortfall
docs: Payoff the collateral did not cover, recorded at priced recovery.

types.name: RequestV2
docs: A borrower's public ask with collateral locked. Funding turns it into an active `OfferV2`.

types.name: TermsArgs
docs: Arguments shared by create_offer and create_request.

fields.name: early_repayment
docs: 0 full-term, 1 pro-rata.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Zero until accepted.
